info.title: Teranga API
info.description: Contrat documenté pour la coordination de missions/opérations (missions, operations, providers, requests, tasks, saved-locations, mission-pricing-rules) et une partie de auth/services. D'autres routes montées et actives n'ont PAS encore de contrat formel ici : activities, categories, countries, dashboard, evidences, franchises, notifications, order-items, orders, products, project-documents, project-phases, projects, properties, property-listings, regions, service-catalog, transactions, users — ainsi que le reste de auth et de services au-delà de /services/me. Ne pas déduire leur absence d'une non-existence : vérifier backend/src/routes/ pour la liste réelle des routes montées.

patch.description: A reserved or active Taxi ride prevents self-service availability changes (409). Conditional writes preserve a driver reservation made concurrently by dispatch. Repeating the current declaration remains successful. Going available for Mobility still checks the driver's active status and vehicle compliance.

400.description: Invalid declaration or compliance requirements unmet.

409.description: Taxi reservation in progress or concurrent availability change.

post.summary: Decline a live offer assigned to the signed-in provider
post.description: Ownership, ASSIGNED status and unexpired pending acceptance are checked under a row lock. A previous acceptance or refusal cannot be undone by a stale request. Successful refusal returns the mission to SEARCHING_EXECUTOR and removes the assignment; the provider must return to their list because dossier access is revoked.

403.description: The offer is no longer assigned to this provider.

get.summary: List the signed-in provider's interventions or the agent's supervised missions
get.description: Ownership is enforced before search, type filtering, counting and pagination. Personal assignments are independent of geographic selectors. Active includes COMPLETED awaiting client confirmation and prioritizes live offers before newer work. Offers requires ASSIGNED and a non-expired acceptance deadline. History uses MISSION_HISTORY_STATUSES. The response is no-store. Unknown query parameters return 400.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Omit to retain the historical all-status list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal substring in title, description or addresses; #123 also matches the exact identifier.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Historical offset pagination; page takes priority when supplied.

parameters.name: excludeTradeCategorySlug
parameters.description: Historical comma-separated category exclusion.

200.description: Missions and pagination (page, limit, offset, total).

get.summary: Find all of the signed-in client's services, projects and orders
get.description: Client role only. Ownership is enforced on every source before global filtering, counting and pagination, without a geographic selector. Linked repeat services remain in their parent dossier. Sorting is newest first, then kind and descending id. Review includes completed services and coordinated completed projects; order payment or shipment never requires client result confirmation. Unknown query parameters return 400.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Service excludes the mobility and delivery categories; all includes every family.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal substring in title, description or order reference; #123 also matches the numeric id. Percent and underscore are literal.

200.description: Complete global pagination, no partial family fallback. Items include typed key (kind:id), kind (service/project/order), numeric id, title, status, missionStatus, paymentStatus, createdAt, review and history booleans. Service summaries include tradeCategory and optional executor name in agent. Project summaries include executor. Orders include an optional summary (first 240 characters of the customer note). Pagination includes page, limit and total. Cache-Control: no-store.

503.description: The complete collection could not be read

get.summary: Find authorized interventions, including completed history
get.description: Role and territory permissions, property context and search apply before pagination. A property filter includes direct interventions and those attached to its services, without granting additional access. Existing response fields are retained. Each intervention can be opened through /tasks/{id}/workspace for its permitted actions.

parameters.name: propertyId
parameters.description: Invalid or empty values return 400 instead of an unfiltered archive.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Exact project context, intersected with existing task permissions before pagination. Project ownership alone does not grant new task access. Invalid values return 400.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Omit service, property and creator objects; expose only assignee id and name. Legacy calls retain their original representation.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal substring of the intervention title, description, service title or property title. Percent and underscore are literal characters.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Legacy pagination; page takes precedence.

200.description: Authorized tasks and pagination with page, limit, offset, count for this page, total and totalPages.

get.summary: Read a role-specific queue of cases to act on or follow
get.description: Read-only projection for clients, agents, providers and administrators. Authorizations and explicit territory filters are applied before grouping and pagination. Authorized steps join an accessible service or project; tasks with no accessible parent remain limited interventions. One card per typed case. Action/following counts cover the filtered case set; unread counts are personal notifications and do not indicate pending work. Reading never changes work or notification states. A missing family is an explicit service error, not an empty queue.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case or authorized step title, order code, or a numeric reference with optional #.

200.description: Items with typed identity, title, current state, pending-step counts, optional next-action target, and exact pagination/summary counts. Action targets are navigation hints; writes retain their original server authorization and prerequisite checks.

503.description: The queue could not be computed; no partial success is reported

get.summary: Read a limited task workspace with its existing capabilities
get.description: Task ownership/assignment and geographic rules are checked. Parent service/property details and creator/email information are omitted. parentServiceId is only provided when the actor may read that service. Task progress, administrative review and evidence use existing write routes and do not complete a parent case.

404.description: Task not found within the caller's access

get.summary: Read mission disputes within the administrator's territory

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: Optional exact case from the work queue; geographic checks remain applied.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Omitting status returns open and investigating disputes.

200.description: Authorized disputes, optionally restricted to one case

get.summary: Read authorized work steps in a service case
get.description: Without workspace=true the legacy full-list response is preserved. The workspace response adds a stable paginated list, exact authorized total, viewer identity, per-step capabilities and a service context only if the viewer can access that service. Assignment to a task alone does not grant service access. Capabilities are a snapshot: writes recheck existing role, assignment and territory rules. Step review is administrative and does not confirm the service result.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Optional exact step in workspace mode. Service membership and task access restrictions apply before pagination; old steps remain reachable.

200.description: Authorized steps. In workspace mode: tasks with capabilities, pagination.total, viewer, canCreate and nullable serviceContext.

get.summary: List the caller's requests, optionally restricted to home priorities
get.description: Clients always see their own requests; administrators keep their existing territory restrictions. Views are applied before counting and pagination. Mission status takes precedence over the legacy service status. Omitting view preserves the existing list.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: review: results awaiting client confirmation. ongoing: nonterminal requests excluding results awaiting confirmation. active: all nonterminal requests including results to review. history: terminal requests.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Family filter applied before counting and pagination; category identifiers are resolved by slug.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text search or an exact numeric reference, optionally prefixed with #.

200.description: Authorized requests and the total matching the view

get.summary: Personal operations updates for any authenticated role
get.description: Combines notifications and activity history for the authenticated recipient only. Reconciles duplicate source copies before filtering and pagination. Does not grant coordination rights or change reading state.

200.description: Personal paginated history, with an unfiltered unread count

400.description: Invalid or unknown filters, or inverted date range

delete.summary: Remove the caller's read information older than 30 days
delete.description: Keeps unread notifications, their related activity history, other recipients' information and all business records and evidence.

200.description: Number of physical source rows removed

delete.summary: Remove one personal update and its duplicate source copy atomically
delete.description: Requires the version returned by GET /operations/updates. Business records and evidence are preserved.

404.description: Information not found for the caller

409.description: Information changed since it was displayed; refresh before removing

get.summary: Administrator operational queue, restricted to the caller's territory
get.description: Escalated requests are ordered first, then dated next actions, before pagination. Search and ownership filters apply equally to services, projects and orders.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Only requests followed by the authenticated administrator; does not widen territorial access.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Service or project title, order code, or exact numeric reference optionally prefixed with #.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Focus one request within the caller's existing territory and permissions

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: Use false to include closed requests when focusing a historical update

patch.summary: Transition mission status (section 2 state machine); allowed transitions depend on caller role
patch.description: For a delivery completed by its executor, the optional collectedAmount declaration is saved atomically with COMPLETED. It creates no payment transaction and never changes recorded payments or the remaining balance. Invalid amounts leave work progress unchanged. Provider completion requirements come from existing coordination or the active catalogue policy when a manual assignment preceded scheduler initialization; required reports cannot be bypassed in that case.

400.description: Invalid transition, or mission has no missionStatus (classic agent flow)

403.description: Caller is not allowed to trigger this transition

get.summary: Read coordination and completion report as customer, assigned agent or administrator

200.description: Resource, coordination and allowed actions. At project handover or order delivery, authorized staff also receive advisory readiness with openPhases, openTasks, hasProof and proofId. Proofs belong to the current actor; project proofs must be a report or photo. Other states and customers receive null readiness. Status writes recheck these requirements transactionally. This read does not advance work or record payment.

400.description: Invalid input or missing completion report

409.description: Invalid stage, remaining work, missing proof or capacity exceeded

collectedAmount.description: Optional amount declared on delivery at COMPLETED; stored separately from payment transactions.
